fixes.explanation: Hills, friend? I get why you'd say it. Joseph is storing food in a lot of places, so a lot of land comes to mind. But the text puts it this way: “In every city he laid up the food from the fields around it.” Each city kept what grew right next door, so the grain only had a short trip to the storehouse.

problems.problem: The cookie rolling down a hill is unrelated to Joseph storing food, so the joke does not pass the joke logic test.
